head.i: POSTERIORIS HVIVS PARTIS ministerii Christi prophetici capita hunc in modum in G. F. connectuntur.

main_text.l: quorundam confirmatio per transfigurationem in monte, cap. 17.
Prophetia de destructione templi & fine mundi.cap.24.
main_text.p: Hactenus narrata sunt ea, quæ pertinent ad ad-ministrationem muneris Prophetici Christi, quaeque præbuerunt occasionem administrationi muneris Sacerdotalis: quatenus nimirum Scribæ & Pharisæi tum doctrinâ tum miraculis Christi, tum maximè reprehensione suæ hypocriseos irritati fuerunt, ad consilium capiendum de illo ad mortem rapien-do. Deinceps sequitur narratio
main_text.head: DE ADMINISTRATIONE MV-eris SACERDOTALIS, nempe historia pas-sionis & mortis Christi.
IN HISTORIA Passionis & mortis Christi

page.notes: Diagram levels read from the braces; the grouping of Metropoli and Commoratio under Ingressus is uncertain. "refutati" is doubtful: the line break after "re" is not clearly hyphenated. "Iudæ" in the diagram may carry a further ligature or letter. "moi tem" in the paragraph is doubtful and was read as "mortem". The "Christi" at the end of the last heading is set right-aligned on its own line. The superscript "52" was read as the page number.
